displayAddress: Mare Street, London Fields, London E8
description:
The Storey: A bright two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment set on the fourth floor of this popular modern development on Mare Street, right in the heart of London Fields.

The apartment has a really good layout, with two proper double bedrooms, two bathrooms and plenty of storage throughout. The open-plan kitchen and living space is one of the best parts of the flat, with a south-facing aspect bringing in loads of natural light and giving the room a really open feel.

The kitchen is modern and well equipped, including a dishwasher, while the washer/dryer is tucked away in a separate cupboard to keep things practical and tidy.

The building itself comes with a lot of useful extras too, including a live-in porter, CCTV, video entry, lift access, secure bike storage and good soundproofing. The apartment can be offered furnished or unfurnished.

The Vibe: You’re right in the middle of London Fields, which means some of East London’s best spots are within easy walking distance.

Broadway Market, Columbia Road Flower Market, London Fields itself and Mare Street are all close by, with no shortage of independent coffee shops, pubs, bakeries and restaurants nearby. Climpson & Sons, Pophams, Mare Street Market and E5 Bakehouse are all easy local favourites.

It’s also a great location for getting around, with London Fields Overground nearby and easy access towards Hackney Central, Shoreditch and the City.

Seals the Deal: Two double bedrooms, two bathrooms, a bright south-facing living space, porter, secure bike storage and a great London Fields location.

Please note: the photographs shown are from an identical apartment within the development and the available property may differ slightly.
